question: Should the experimental Claws stack standardize newly exported packages on `CLAW.md` now, while continuing to accept grouped JSON manifests as compatibility input?
rationale: The parser and exporter can be reviewed mechanically, but choosing the canonical public package artifact and landing order for this protected stacked feature is product and upgrade policy that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md canonical format
options.body: Keep JSON input compatibility, require current-head lifecycle proof, and land this slice only after its active lifecycle bases are accepted.

options.title: Keep JSON as the canonical export for now
options.body: Defer the export-format transition until the wider Claws lifecycle and package ecosystem direction is settled.

options.title: Pause the experimental Claws stack
options.body: Do not accept a canonical format commitment until maintainers decide whether the overall experimental feature should proceed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md canonical format
recommendation.body: Keep JSON input compatibility, require current-head lifecycle proof, and land this slice only after its active lifecycle bases are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed owner candidate for the active Claws proposal stack and can provide the requested behavior proof and design context.
